scripts.build: pnpm run build:declarations && cross-env BUILD_PLATFORM=web vite build
scripts.build:web: pnpm run build:declarations && cross-env BUILD_PLATFORM=web vite build
scripts.build:all: pnpm run build:web && pnpm run build:mobile
scripts.test-storybook:ci: concurrently -k -s first -n "SB,TEST" -c "magenta,blue" "pnpm run storybook" "wait-on tcp:6009 && pnpm run test-storybook"
scripts.test:all: pnpm run test && pnpm run test:stories
